**Mathematical Condition for Constructibility:**
A number $\alpha$ is constructible if and only if it can be obtained from rational numbers using a finite number of operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and extraction of square roots.
In terms of field theory, $\alpha$ is constructible if and only if the degree of the field extension $[\mathbb{Q}(\alpha) : \mathbb{Q}]$ is a power of 2 (i.e., $2^k$ for some non-negative integer $k$).
